name: Mythology of the Titans
summary: In Ironforge, Librarian Mae Paledust seeks Mythology of the Titans, a book said to have rested in Tirisfal's old Monastery. Its study may show what the past can teach about the unknown ahead.

sections.title: A Lost Volume
sections.body: Before trouble came to Lordaeron, the old Monastery in Tirisfal Glades kept a library of knowledge. Mae asks you to bring her a book called Mythology of the Titans. It is said to be there, and she hopes its study will uncover secrets of the past.

faq.q: Who is asking for the book?
faq.answer: Librarian Mae Paledust in Ironforge asks you to bring her Mythology of the Titans.

faq.q: Where is Mythology of the Titans said to be?
faq.answer: The book is rumored to be in the library of the old Monastery in Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: What is Mythology of the Titans?
faq.answer: Mythology of the Titans is a book said to have been kept in the old Monastery's library in Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: Why does Mae want the book?
faq.answer: Mae hopes studying the book may reveal secrets of the past and help prepare for the unknown.

attribution: In-game quest text: Mythology of the Titans
